tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards (Apple's grouped background). Only headings, secondary text and accent text sit directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, sheets: the main reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered list rows and cards on surface.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Control fills: text fields, segmented-control track, secondary buttons, tags.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of fills.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and inside cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edge of text fields and checkboxes (3:1 on surface and fill).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and fill.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: company names, meta lines, descriptions. On canvas, surface and fill.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints, timestamps, axis labels. On surface (Mocha also on canvas). In Latte it equals text-secondary to keep 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand accent (Mauve): primary buttons, the selected segment, score rings. Fills and marks; for accent TEXT use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and text buttons on canvas, surface and accent-soft. Latte darkens Mauve to keep 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent-text: selected nav items, active filters.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Plain hyperlinks (external pages, LinkedIn). Latte darkens Blue to keep 4.5:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (3:1 on canvas, surface and fill).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Good-state fills and marks: Applied, score at or above target.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success label text, on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill background for success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention fills and marks: Needs manual, low confidence.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning label text, on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill and callout background for warnings.

tokens.name: serious
tokens.usage: Serious fills and marks: Resume too weak, below the score cutoff.

tokens.name: serious-text
tokens.usage: Serious label text, on surface and serious-soft.

tokens.name: serious-soft
tokens.usage: Status pill background for serious states.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: Error status, Remove, Quit.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive button labels, on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error pill and callout background.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational marks: External application, tips.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info callout background; its text stays text and text-secondary.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of bars and score rings.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasized bars (values below the cutoff).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and modals.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Translucent top bar, used with the material-blur backdrop.

families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Apple-style large titles: tight tracking, heavy weight, only at the top of a page or sheet.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per page: the page name, text on canvas.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Job title at the top of a detail sheet.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Apple's text styles, one notch down for dense data screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Claude rewrote your resume for this posting without inventing anything.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Apply on the company site; your tailored resume is ready.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Meta lines under a title, in text-secondary.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels inside cards, in text-tertiary.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts) for scores and counts: the terminal half of the Catppuccin feel. Always tabular.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Stat tiles and the number inside a score ring.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Scores in lists, counts, usage figures, log lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; pill padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row padding block; gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List-row padding inline; compact card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Default card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of a page under the bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips and keyword tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields and the segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts, rows inside a card, the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped lists: the signature corner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals and the onboarding window.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, toggles: anything you press or that names a state.

shadow.note: Soft and low. Elevation is mostly the canvas-to-surface step; shadows only separate floating things.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, toasts and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected segment and toggle knobs.

material.note: Apple-style vibrancy for bars that float over content.

tokens.name: material-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of the top bar, over the material color token.
